timing_scope.first_valid_seconds: uniform construction + required LLL/BKZ/database setup + current arm through first public-valid candidate; other arms and checkpoint I/O excluded
timing_scope.total_first_valid_seconds: actual worker wall time through first public-valid candidate, including earlier arms and checkpoints
timing_scope.setup_includes: public matrix, basis and all target construction; decoder imports/initialization and reductions required by that arm
timing_scope.checkpoint_io_seconds: JSONL serialization/flush and atomic JSON checkpoint serialization/write/replace
